def stamp_marker_motif(grid):
    """Stamp the non-background motif (largest non-bg cluster) centered on every other non-bg (marker) cell."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = [[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    comps = []
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if grid[r][c] != bg and not seen[r][c]:
                q = deque([(r, c)]); seen[r][c] = True; comp = []
                while q:
                    a, b = q.popleft(); comp.append((a, b))
                    for da, db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na, nb = a+da, b+db
                        if 0 <= na < H and 0 <= nb < W and grid[na][nb] != bg and not seen[na][nb]:
                            seen[na][nb] = True; q.append((na, nb))
                comps.append(comp)
    if not comps: return grid
    motif = max(comps, key=len)
    if len(motif) == 1: return grid
    rs = [p[0] for p in motif]; cs = [p[1] for p in motif]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    motif_g = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1+1)] for r in range(r0, r1+1)]
    h, w = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    mset = set(motif)
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
